description: This file defines an abstract base class for API tests in the OrangeHRM project, providing setup methods and configuration handling for API testing with JUnit 5.

classes.name: BaseApiTest
classes.description: Abstract base class for API testing, handling setup and configuration for OrangeHRM API tests.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes configuration and API client before each test; configures Allure metadata.

methods.name: guardDiscoveryOnly
methods.description: Checks if discovery-only mode is active; if not, reinitializes config and client, asserting required environment variables.
